Prophet living at the time of Divided Monarchy

A farmer's son who was ploughing when Elijah threw his cloak over him. He left the oxen, followed, and asked for a double portion of Elijah's spirit when the older man was taken up. His miracles run from poisoned water made clean to Naaman healed of leprosy, and a dead man thrown into his tomb came back to life when he touched the bones.
